newsitem.title: UK: Halifax to detail conversion timing soon.
newsitem.headline: Halifax to detail conversion timing soon.

text.p: The UK's Halifax Building Society said on Wednesday that details of the timing of its conversion to bank status and 10 billion stg London stock market float were likely to be released later this week or possibly next week.

But a spokeswoman for the building society denied there was an announcement planned on share allocations for members - savers and borrowers - of the mutually-owned society, who are due to receive shares when it floats in June 1997.
"There may be a release going out later this week or next week (on the timing of conversion)," the spokeswoman told Reuters in response to a question on share allocations.
In August the Halifax said an announcement about the organisation of dealings in its new shares would be made soon.
The flotation is expected to bring the biggest-ever single boost to share ownership in Britain, with around nine million investors on the Halifax share register.

The society said it was important to create the right structure for an "orderly market" in the shares, with several hundred thousand shares likely to change hands on the first day of trading as people cash in their windfalls.
